This is distinct from mild self-limited acute HBV; the degree of ALT elevation (>10× ULN) plus jaundice places the patient in the higher-risk category for fulminant evolution. The emphasis on synthetic function testing (INR, albumin) and viral load reflects appropriate risk stratification — high HBV DNA may suggest less robust immune-mediated clearance and potentially inform antiviral decisions if decompensation develops.

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Severe acute hepatitis B virus infection
